description: Variation under section 73of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) of the following conditions imposed on planning permission ref 47853/93/246 dated 20th November 2001 for the development of an additional passenger terminal complex at Heathrow Airport (Terminal 5), to include the provision of airport aprons, taxiways and associated facilities, infrastructure for aircraft maintenance, a hotel, offices, car parking, rail and underground stations, road connections to airport and public highway networks, an air traffic visual control room, re-alignment of rivers and landscaping: Condition A18 - form and design of the roof of the main Core Terminal Building (CTB); Condition A30 - maximum dimensions of the three principal rows of buidlings in the designated Landside Area, and Condition 43 - design and external appearance of the three principal rows of buildings in the designated Landside Area
